name: artificial-analysis
description: Independent benchmarks for models and API providers: intelligence, price, speed and latency for language models, plus arena rankings for image, video, speech and music models.

interface.longDescription:
Artificial Analysis independently benchmarks models and the API providers that serve them. Connect it to answer questions with current measurements instead of what a model remembers from training.

Language models: the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and its evaluations, coding and agentic indexes, context window, price per million tokens, and output speed and time to first token measured across providers.

API providers: compare how each provider serves a model on speed, latency and price, with performance over time.

Media models: arena rankings for text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, speech-to-speech and music.

Every tool is read-only. Sign in with your Artificial Analysis account and choose an organization. Calls count against that organization's API quota, and the data you see follows its plan.
capabilities: Compare language models on intelligence, price and speed
Compare API providers serving the same model
Rank image, video, speech and music models
Explain any benchmark field and how it is measured
defaultPrompt: Which language models lead the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index right now?
Which of the top ten models on the Intelligence Index has the fastest median output speed?
What are the top text-to-video models on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena?

positive.prompt: Which five language models have the highest Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls /language/models/free and lists five models with their index scores and the index version from the response.

positive.description: Filter models by price and score
positive.prompt: Which models score above 50 on the Intelligence Index and cost under $1 per million input tokens?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads model scores and price_1m_input_tokens from /language/models/free and returns only the models meeting both limits, or says none do.

positive.prompt: Which of the top ten models on the Intelligence Index has the fastest median output speed, and what is its time to first token?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads index scores and median performance from /language/models/free, ranks the top ten by index, and names the fastest by output speed with its time to first token.

positive.prompt: What are the top five text-to-video models on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls aa_media_rankings_free with modality text-to-video and lists the five highest-rated models with their arena ratings.

positive.prompt: In Artificial Analysis data, what does time to first token measure, and can it be missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the field's meaning, type and nullability from the live API contract without inventing a definition.

negative.description: Media generation is out of scope
negative.prompt: Generate an image of a lighthouse at sunset.

negative.description: Account changes are out of scope
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Artificial Analysis plan and add a teammate to my organization.
What's the weather in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin reads benchmark data. It does not sell products, process payments or change subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to Artificial Analysis language, provider and media benchmarks.
